area: operator shell, model surface, tooltips and manual, cross-cutting, architecture, val, par, quiet, pw, his, null-domain foundation and legacy

method.summary: Read prefilter, grouped by clause, anchor number and unit_kind. Opened MT contracts (clause, scope, acceptance) and the code by git grep and reads. Classified per sampled MT. No cargo, no build, no test run: BUILT means a test exists and reads as proving it, not that it passed today.

verdict_rules.BUILT: behaviour exists and a test covers it, asset-local
verdict_rules.PARTIAL: part of the clause exists; evidence says which
verdict_rules.GUI_ONLY_GAP: engine plus test exist; only registry, GUI, manual or host obligation is unmet
verdict_rules.NOT_CODE: extra class: spec bookkeeping, declared debt or policy with no code acceptance

method.prefilter_warning: Anchor flags are unreliable for this area: all 362 tool rows and 90 panel rows are flagged anchored on one comment each. Sampled rows were judged on the code.
method.sampling: Shell, panel and tool samples are purposive, stratified by clause range and family, not random. Legacy and companion samples are seeded random, split by anchored and unanchored. Domains under 28 rows were opened in full. Every estimate carries that limit.
method.grep_noise: Some zero-hit claims rest on term greps with synonyms tried. A capability under an unguessed name would be missed: treat single MISSING rows as UNVERIFIED until a lane scopes them.
method.scratchpad_note: Sibling auditors share the session scratchpad; this audit wrote only under scratchpad/shell_audit plus a stray load.py at the scratchpad root.
